about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking Circle Internet Group, Inc. Users get linear exposure to Circle share-price moves without owning shares, voting rights, or dividend claims. Pricing uses Felix’s external reference methodology for equity markets. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the flx namespace, but are operated by Felix rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
